title: Add aisle number signs hanging from ceiling
description: Real video stores had hanging signs above each aisle indicating the genre. These should hang from the ceiling on thin supports.
design: For each shelf row, add a hanging sign mesh suspended from the ceiling. Two-sided text with genre name. Thin wire/pole connecting to ceiling.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Signs hang above each aisle
- [ ] Genre name is readable from both directions
- [ ] Signs are at a height that doesn't block walking
- [ ] Visual connection to ceiling (wire or pole)

title: Add crouch/kneel to see bottom shelf rows
description: Player needs to be able to crouch down to see the bottom rows of VHS boxes on the shelves. Currently the camera is at standing eye height and bottom rows are hard to see.
design: Add Shift key (or C key) to crouch — lower camera.position.y from 1.6 to 0.8. Toggle or hold. On mobile, add a crouch button.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Pressing Shift or C lowers camera to crouch height
- [ ] Releasing returns to standing
- [ ] Bottom shelf rows clearly visible when crouched
- [ ] Crouch button on mobile

title: Add storefront windows and night sky exterior
description: Front wall needs glass windows showing dark night sky outside, and the iconic Blockbuster awning above the entrance.
design: Semi-transparent window planes on front wall. Dark gradient behind them for night sky. Blue/yellow awning mesh above door.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Front wall has window panels flanking the door
- [ ] Windows show dark night sky
- [ ] Blue/yellow awning visible above entrance
- [ ] Warm interior contrasts with dark exterior

title: Responsive overlay panels for mobile screens
description: The shelf browser, dialogue, trivia, and puzzle overlays need to work on small screens. Currently sized for desktop.
design: Make overlay panels full-screen on mobile (< 768px). Increase font sizes and button targets to 44px minimum. Ensure scroll works in panels. Add swipe-down to dismiss. Test on 375px width (iPhone SE).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Overlays are full-screen on mobile
- [ ] All buttons are at least 44px tap targets
- [ ] Text is readable on small screens
- [ ] Scroll works within panels
- [ ] Close button easily accessible

title: Add endcap displays at shelf row ends
description: Real Blockbusters had promotional endcap displays at the end of each aisle — featured movies, staff picks, or themed collections.
design: Add small perpendicular shelf units at the ends of each rack row. Display 3-4 face-out VHS boxes. Label them STAFF PICKS or JUST ADDED.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Each shelf row has an endcap on at least one end
- [ ] Endcaps show face-out VHS boxes with posters
- [ ] Endcaps have a label/sign
- [ ] They don't block aisle movement

title: Improve lighting with warm fluorescent glow and shadows
description: Lighting should feel more like real fluorescent store lighting — bright but slightly warm, with visible light pools on shelves and floor.
design: Add spotlights angled down from each fixture. Increase light intensity near shelves. Add subtle warm color variation. Consider adding a slight flicker animation to one light.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Light pools visible on floor beneath fixtures
- [ ] Shelves are well-lit, not dark
- [ ] Overall brightness matches a real store
- [ ] At least one light has subtle flicker

title: Add loading screen for 3D assets
description: When the 3D store loads, there's a brief blank period while Three.js initializes and textures load. Need a loading screen with progress.
design: Show a styled loading overlay until the Canvas onCreated fires and first frame renders. Display Friday Night Video logo with a loading bar or spinner. Fade out when ready.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Loading screen shows before 3D renders
- [ ] Has the FNV branding
- [ ] Fades out smoothly when store is ready
- [ ] Works on both mobile and desktop

title: Add entrance door with push bar and window
description: The entrance needs a proper door with a glass window panel, push bar, and PULL/PUSH text. Should look like a real commercial storefront door.
design: Glass door mesh with semi-transparent material. Metal push bar across the middle. PUSH text on the glass. Door frame in dark metal color.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Door has a glass panel
- [ ] Push bar visible across the door
- [ ] PUSH text on the glass
- [ ] Door frame looks like commercial metal frame
- [ ] Door is in the correct position in the front wall

title: Deploy to Vercel
description: Get the game deployed on Vercel. The project is Next.js 16 with Three.js. Needs env vars (OPENAI_API_KEY, TMDB_API_KEY) set in Vercel dashboard. Already has a .vercel directory from previous deployment.
design:
1. Commit all current changes to git
2. Push to GitHub (repo: JDaws-Dev/JARVIS or create new repo)
3. Connect to Vercel via CLI or dashboard
4. Set env vars: OPENAI_API_KEY, TMDB_API_KEY
5. Deploy
6. Verify /game route works on production URL
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] All current code committed and pushed
- [ ] Vercel deployment succeeds
- [ ] Environment variables configured
- [ ] /game route loads and 3D store renders
- [ ] API routes work (puzzle, search, image-proxy)
- [ ] Production URL accessible

title: Add Blockbuster-yellow accent stripe along walls
description: Real Blockbusters had a signature yellow stripe running along the top of the walls. Add this detail to all interior walls.
design: Thin yellow mesh strip running along all walls at about 2.8m height. Emissive material for slight glow.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Yellow stripe runs along all 4 walls
- [ ] Stripe is at consistent height
- [ ] Slight emissive glow like painted accent

title: Add mobile touch controls for 3D store
description: The 3D store needs touch controls for mobile — virtual joystick for movement and touch-to-look for camera rotation. Currently only works with keyboard/mouse.
design: Add a virtual joystick overlay (bottom-left) using touch events. Add touch-drag on the canvas for camera look. Add a tap-to-interact button (bottom-right). Detect mobile via touch support and show controls only on touch devices.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Virtual joystick appears on touch devices
- [ ] Joystick controls WASD movement
- [ ] Touch drag on canvas rotates camera
- [ ] Tap button for interaction with objects
- [ ] Controls don't appear on desktop
- [ ] Movement feels smooth on mobile

title: Add ceiling drop-tile grid
description: Real stores have drop-ceiling tile grids. The ceiling should show visible tile lines, not a flat white surface.
design: Add a grid of thin dark lines on the ceiling mesh using additional meshes or a canvas texture. Tiles approximately 2x2 feet.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Ceiling shows visible grid pattern
- [ ] Tiles are roughly square
- [ ] Fluorescent fixtures sit in the grid naturally
- [ ] Visible when looking up

title: Add checkout counter details — monitor, scanner, tape cases
description: The counter area needs more detail — a computer monitor facing Vinny, a barcode scanner, stacked VHS cases waiting to be reshelved, a membership card sign.
design: Add a monitor mesh behind the counter facing Vinny. Scanner as a small red-lined box. Stack of VHS cases on the counter. MEMBERSHIP CARDS sign.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Monitor visible behind counter
- [ ] Barcode scanner on counter
- [ ] Stack of returned VHS cases on counter
- [ ] Membership sign near register

title: Optimize 3D performance for mobile
description: The 3D store may be too heavy for mobile devices. Need to reduce draw calls, limit texture loading, and ensure smooth 30fps on phones.
design: Reduce VHS box count on mobile (5 per tier instead of 10). Use lower resolution textures (w185 instead of w342). Reduce light count. Add devicePixelRatio cap at 2. Reduce fog distance. Lazy-load shelf textures based on proximity.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Runs at 30fps+ on iPhone/Android
- [ ] Reduced geometry count on mobile
- [ ] Smaller texture sizes on mobile
- [ ] No visible lag when walking around
- [ ] DPR capped at 2

title: Add movie poster frames on side walls
description: The colored rectangle wall posters should be actual TMDB movie posters in frames, not just solid color blocks.
design: Load TMDB poster images via the proxy into the WallPoster component. Use the same blob->texture approach as PosterBox. Larger frames with visible borders.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Wall posters show real movie images
- [ ] Posters are in visible frames
- [ ] At least 4 posters on the walls
- [ ] Images load via the proxy without CORS errors

title: Improve floor with Blockbuster carpet pattern
description: The floor should look like real Blockbuster commercial carpet — dark blue with subtle pattern, not flat solid color.
design: Use a repeating texture pattern via a canvas-generated texture. Dark blue base with slightly lighter blue speckle pattern. Entrance area stays gray tile.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Floor has visible carpet texture, not flat color
- [ ] Blue carpet covers main store area
- [ ] Gray tile near entrance is distinct
- [ ] Floor looks like commercial carpet from eye level
